text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I come across Air Shakur out in
town,
and we decide to head back to
the academy
together. On the way...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur doesn't look all that
interested, but I
remember receiving a
raffle ticket earlier when I
was shopping.
I hold it out to her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Why? Do it yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Are you serious?
choice_data_list: シャカールなら狙ったものを当てられそう

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Listen, raffles aren't about gettin' what
you want.
The anticipation of what you
might end up with is
what makes them
fun.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Where's your sense of adventure?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: 'Course I don't.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like she could not be less
invested in the
raffle, but if we manage
to win the grand prize...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Um... So are you two interested in giving
this a
whirl, or are you just standing
there for fun?
choice_data_list: （シャカールの息抜きになるかも）

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Oho, very nice. And what do you have
your eyes
on?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What, you plannin' on enterin' this thing
a million
times? There's no way you'll
actually win that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. Go on and spin it
already.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A glint of poorly concealed interest
shines in Air
Shakur's eyes as she
watches me turn the handle
on the raffle
machine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ooh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, well, well. Who would've thunk?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey. How many people have entered
this raffle so
far? And what are the odds
of winning the grand
prize?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tell me the demographics of everyone
who tried
and how they turned the
handle... Have you been
tracking all the
statistics?.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Um... I don't have a clue about any of
that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Figures.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
But I mean, you won the grand prize...
Aren't you
happy? It's not every day you
get to go on a hot
spring vacation.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the one who wanted it in the first
place.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer! You go ahead and
enjoy your
trip!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I thought you wanted that coupon.
Wouldn't hurt
to be more cheerful about
it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: シャカールは温泉好きじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't have anythin' against 'em. I just
don't like
the idea of a makin' a whole
trip out of it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I hate constantly bein' around people as
is, so
why would I wanna sit around in a
bath with a
bunch of strangers?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I just use the showers when no one's
around.
choice_data_list: 普段のお風呂はどうしてるんだ？
普段のお風呂はどうしてるの？

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You have to shower before getting in
the bath
anyways, so why bother? I only
get in if I have to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not a fan of long, relaxing soaks—noted.
I guess
she wouldn't enjoy visiting a hot
spring very
much, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What's with the questions, anyway?
You're
usually always so careful about
boundaries.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, you're startin' to creep me out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, despite miraculously winning the
grand
prize, the fate of the vacation
coupon remains
unclear...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
First prize, huh? Wasn't exactly what
you were
aiming for, though. Too bad.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, technically it's a good prize. But
do you
even want that?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't offload your trash on me.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you don't want it? But a lot of
Umamusume
come here specifically to
try for the carrot
hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Cool story. Too bad I'm not one of them.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: But it's really, really delicious! The local butchers, bakeries, greengrocers, and restaurants all came together to create this! It's the shopping district's pride and joy!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Looks like it. Good for you.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Huh. You're not even the slightest bit
tempted to
try it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'll eat it if I need the fuel.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
No, no! My pride is at stake here. This
prize was
designed to make our
Umamusume customers
happy.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you leave until you're
satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ma! You there?! Warm up this
hamburger
steak for me!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The hell? I said I don't want it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One thing leads to another, and Air
Shakur ends
up trying the deluxe carrot
hamburger steak on
the spot. After her
first bite...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo! I told you it's delicious!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm no culinary connoisseur or
whatever,
but this isn't half bad.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
All right, now let's see those pearly
whites!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Not a chance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Air Shakur finishes her
meal.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...They sure are orange.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
And packed with plenty of nutrients.
Bon appetit!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We can have these delivered if you'd
like... but
I'm sure your friend here can
carry them no
problem.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh?
choice_data_list: いえ、自分で持ち帰ります

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
They're quite heavy, you know. Are you
sure?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've developed a habit of doing the same

exercises I think up for Air Shakur to
gain a better
understanding of their
benefits. I think I'm quite
fit for my age.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...We could at least rent a cart or
something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to take Air Shakur's advice and
borrow a
cart from the shopping district
to wheel the
carrots back to the
academy. However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess pushing it slows me down too
much,
because Air Shakur leaves me
behind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take a few more steps forward until...
choice_data_list: （自分で言ったんだから、頑張ろう！）

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Are you the trainer who's
distributing carrots
to everyone?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I saw a post on Umatter about a trainer
heading
toward Tracen handing out a
ton of carrots to
people!
choice_data_list: にんじん配りトレーナーさん！？

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping I could nab a bunch for
myself if I
caught you early!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to have some too. As many as
possible,
please!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh! We'd like some carrots too, please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In no time, a mob of Umamusume
descends upon
me, and the carrots
disappear faster than I can
figure out
what's happening.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time I arrive on campus, there are
none
left. That's not the way I planned
to hand out
carrots, but all things
considered, I'm glad it
worked out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just when I finish making a mental note
to thank
my mystery benefactor, another
Umamusume
approaches me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You're the one passing out carrots,
right? Hi
there!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My new reputation continues to plague
me for
some time.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: One carrot, huh? Too bad.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tough luck. Hurry up and take your
prize already.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Heh, look at you standing there holding
your lone
carrot.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're like the perfect illustration of
dumbstruck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This could be my chance to entertain Air
Shakur! I
hoist up the carrot like a sword.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...And you killed it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Forcing a joke's the best way to sour it.
It was
only funny before because it was
spontaneous.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And stop trying to suck up to me. It's
gross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After I get home, the sweetness of the
carrot
offers me some small comfort.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sucks to be you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I had a feeling this's what you'd
end up
with, statistically speaking.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: シャカールを温泉に連れていきたかった

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hmph. So that's what this was all about.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I wanted to go in the first
place, so
what are you all disappointed
for? Cut it out,
loser.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, she does look the
slightest
bit disappointed.
...Or maybe
that's just what I'm telling myself.
